entries.problem: The aluminium-filter cleaning indicator appears on the display
entries.possibleCause: The indicator appears after approximately 60 hours of fan operation and means that the aluminium filters need cleaning.
entries.safeUserCheck: Clean the aluminium filters. With the hood switched off, hold the indicated control for approximately 3 seconds to clear the reminder.
entries.claimTrigger: No service claim is required for the normal filter-cleaning reminder.
entries.sourceSection: PDF p. 12/24, Indication to clean the aluminium filters

entries.problem: Aluminium grease filter requires cleaning
entries.possibleCause: The grease filter collects grease during normal operation and must be cleaned regularly; a saturated filter is flammable.
entries.safeUserCheck: Disconnect the hood before cleaning. Clean the aluminium grease filter every month in a dishwasher or by hand with mild detergent, as described in the manual.
entries.claimTrigger: No service claim is required for normal grease-filter cleaning.

entries.problem: Aluminium filter changes colour after being washed
entries.possibleCause: The filter colour can change after repeated dishwasher washing.
entries.safeUserCheck: No corrective action is required for colour change alone.
entries.claimTrigger: Do not create a claim for aluminium-filter discolouration alone; it does not indicate a defect.

entries.problem: Activated charcoal filter requires replacement
entries.possibleCause: In recirculation mode, the charcoal filter absorbs odours until saturated.
entries.safeUserCheck: Only for recirculation use: replace the charcoal filter every 3ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…â€œ4 months, or more often with intensive use. It cannot be washed or regenerated.
entries.claimTrigger: No service claim is required for normal charcoal-filter replacement.

entries.problem: Acrylic grease filter requires replacement
entries.possibleCause: Some versions use an acrylic filter rather than an aluminium filter.
entries.safeUserCheck: Confirm the installed filter type. If it is acrylic, replace it at least every 2 months, or more often with intensive use.
entries.claimTrigger: No claim is required for scheduled acrylic-filter replacement.

entries.problem: Hood is being used without the aluminium grease filter
entries.possibleCause: The grease filter has been removed or is missing.
entries.safeUserCheck: Stop using the hood and reinstall the correct aluminium grease filter before operation. Do not operate without it because accumulated grease may create a fire hazard.
entries.claimTrigger: Escalate if the correct filter cannot be installed or the filter mounting is damaged.
evidenceToRequest: photo of the filter and mounting
product model and serial number

entries.problem: Hood fan starts when the telescopic front panel is pulled out
entries.possibleCause: The limit switch starts the hood at the previously selected fan speed.
entries.safeUserCheck: No corrective action is required for this normal behaviour.
entries.claimTrigger: Do not create a claim for this behaviour alone.

entries.problem: Fan-speed number flashes while the hood continues running
entries.possibleCause: A flashing fan-speed number indicates the approximately 15-minute delayed switch-off timer is active.
entries.safeUserCheck: Allow the timer to finish, or push the telescopic panel in to cancel it.
entries.claimTrigger: No service claim is required when the flashing display is caused by the normal timer.

entries.problem: Power cable is damaged
entries.possibleCause: A damaged power cable must be replaced by specialist service.
entries.safeUserCheck: Stop using the hood. Disconnect it only if safe. Do not repair or replace the cable yourself.
entries.claimTrigger: Create an urgent service claim for a damaged cable or exposed electrical parts.
evidenceToRequest: photo of cable if safe
product model and serial number
description of damage

entries.problem: Hood lighting does not work
entries.possibleCause: The lighting module or its electrical supply may be faulty.
entries.safeUserCheck: Check that the lighting control is switched on. Do not open or repair the lighting or wiring. If the light remains faulty, contact authorised service.
entries.claimTrigger: Create a service claim if the light remains faulty after checking the control; escalate immediately for damaged wiring or electrical parts.
evidenceToRequest: photo or video of the lighting problem
product model and serial number
description of checks completed

entries.problem: Hood operates while a fuel-burning appliance is used in the same room
entries.possibleCause: Insufficient fresh-air supply can create dangerous negative pressure and combustion-gas risk.
entries.safeUserCheck: Ensure adequate room ventilation and follow local extraction-safety requirements. Stop use if fumes or combustion gases are suspected.
entries.claimTrigger: Escalate urgently for smoke, fumes, dizziness, or suspected combustion-gas exposure; installation/ventilation issues require qualified service.
evidenceToRequest: description of the other appliance
description of fumes or symptoms
installation details if available

entries.safeUserCheck: No action is required when Fast Cool stops automatically. Select the desired temperature with SET to stop it sooner.
entries.claimTrigger: No claim is required for automatic Fast Cool deactivation alone.

entries.problem: Accessible refrigerator condensate drain requires cleaning
entries.possibleCause: The condensate discharge opening may become clogged, depending on the model.
entries.safeUserCheck: If an accessible drain opening is present, disconnect the appliance and carefully clean it with the supplied cleaning plug.
entries.claimTrigger: Create a claim if drainage remains blocked or water continues collecting after cleaning.

entries.problem: Frozen food has partially thawed
entries.possibleCause: The manual warns that partly thawed food must not be refrozen.
entries.safeUserCheck: Do not refreeze partly thawed food. Follow local food-safety guidance and discard food if its safety is uncertain.
entries.claimTrigger: No appliance claim is created for the food-safety instruction alone; create a claim only when an appliance fault caused the thawing.

entries.problem: Carbonated bottle or can stored in the freezer
entries.possibleCause: Carbonated drinks can expand and burst when frozen.
entries.safeUserCheck: Remove carbonated bottles or cans from the freezer. Do not store them there because they may explode.
entries.claimTrigger: Escalate only if an exploding container caused appliance damage or injury.
evidenceToRequest: photo of any resulting damage if safe

entries.problem: Frozen product causes cold injury when eaten immediately
entries.possibleCause: Frozen products can cause severe frostbite because of their very low temperature.
entries.safeUserCheck: Do not put frozen products or ice directly into the mouth. Allow them to warm appropriately before consuming.
entries.claimTrigger: Seek medical assistance for a cold injury; an appliance claim is not created for this warning alone.

entries.problem: Fridge-freezer malfunction remains after manual checks
entries.possibleCause: The manual does not provide a customer-repairable cause for unresolved faults.
entries.safeUserCheck: Do not open or modify the appliance. Contact authorised service and provide the serial number.
entries.claimTrigger: Create a service claim when a malfunction remains after the supported safe checks.
evidenceToRequest: photo or video of the malfunction
product model and serial number
checks already completed
entries.sourceSection: OL-KGCN388140E manual, p. 56 - Warranty and after-sales service

entries.problem: Cooking zone switches off after approximately one minute because suitable cookware is not detected
entries.possibleCause: No cookware is present, or the cookware is unsuitable for induction or too small for the zone.
entries.safeUserCheck: Place flat, induction-compatible cookware with a suitable ferromagnetic base on the zone. The automatic shutoff is normal when no suitable cookware is detected.
entries.claimTrigger: Create a service claim if suitable cookware is still not detected on an appropriate cooking zone.
evidenceToRequest: photo of cookware base or induction marking
description of zones and cookware tested
matchTerms: zone turns off after one minute

entries.problem: A Kitchen Timer or timed-operation setting needs to be cancelled
entries.possibleCause: A timer or timed cooking programme is active.
entries.safeUserCheck: Cancel the Kitchen Timer or timed operation using the programmer controls described in the manual. No claim is needed for normal timer operation.
entries.claimTrigger: Create a service claim only if the timer cannot be cancelled or the controls malfunction.

entries.problem: The grill is being used with the oven door open
entries.possibleCause: The manual requires the oven door to remain closed during grilling.
entries.safeUserCheck: Close the oven door while grilling and keep children away from hot accessible parts.
entries.claimTrigger: No claim is needed when the grill operates normally with the door closed. Escalate only if the door cannot close or the grill malfunctions.
